generation.prompt: Create a character reference sheet of ONLY the little WHITE CRUMPLED PAPER character on the RIGHT in the provided image. Preserve that character identity, not the yellow sponge. Original Korean understated empathy comic, endearingly pathetic paper object, irregular softly angular crumpled outline with small wavy squiggles and fuzzy charcoal pencil-ink edges; white/pale neutral gray fill, a few simple light-gray angular crease strokes, widely spaced tiny black dot eyes, very short mouth, tiny stick arms and legs, no clothes/nose/fingers/hair. Square spacious six-pose sheet, three columns two rows, NO labels: top left front neutral, top middle 3/4 turning with a tiny hand wave, top right anxious with outer corners folding slightly inward; bottom left scrunched into a smaller compact ball looking at a tiny dark gray smartphone, bottom middle looking surprised at the phone, bottom right only slightly unfolded still visibly wrinkled, sitting and looking down at the same phone with a very subtle closed-mouth relieved smile.
